newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - McDonald's rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - McDonald's rating cut.

text.p: -- Everen Securities Inc said Monday it lowered its long-term rating on McDonald's Corp to market perform from outperform. Its near-term rating remains market perform.
-- Last week, McDonald's franchisees approved a discount program that brings the price of sandwiches on a rotating basis to $0.55 when purchased with french fries and a drink.
-- "We expect margins to continue falling under this program," Everen analyst Dean Haskell said. Margins also are being impacted by rising costs.
-- "We previously estimated that beef prices would begin to rise in mid-1997, but now we expect beef prices to begin rising later this year," Haskell said.
-- The 1997 earnings estimate remains $2.45 a share, with 1998 estimated at $2.65.
